segments.x: I think about death often, not in a morbid way. I often write in my journal, my own eulogy, what I would want someone to say at my funeral. I just want to think and be present.
I have done everything I've wanted to do. That I've lived a life that's complete. And if I was to leave today, that I wouldn't have any regrets. I embrace death in the same way that I embrace life.
